conditions: Guide lists Leech enchants for head, shoulders and boots; it favours Leech in raid and Avoidance slightly in Mythic+, and prefers gear with Leech or Avoidance over slightly higher item level without tertiaries.

Telluric Eversong Diamond needs all four gem colours; the guide names Quick Amethyst and Masterful Garnet as usually best for remaining sockets. Weapon Rite of the Hash'ey is an equal option to Acuity of the Ren'dorei; rings compare Zul'jin's Mastery with Eyes of the Eagle.
